verdict.rationale: AMD's documentation confirms PCIe 5.0 storage support and NVMe boot with RAID 0/1/5/10. That covers part of the fast-storage element of the story. However, the PCIe 5.0 claim and the Wi-Fi 6E mention come from the generic Ryzen family page, not the 9950X3D spec sheet, and no lane counts or external I/O details are given. Missing for 10: PCIe lane counts and allocation, a PCIe generation spec for GPU/expansion on the product page, USB/Thunderbolt/USB4 external connectivity specs, and independent corroboration of I/O capabilities.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform has documented I/O headroom — PCIe generation and lanes, fast storage, and external connectivity specs I can plan a build or dock setup around
